view: Frontal chest radiograph (probably AP: scapulae overlie the lateral lung fields, clavicles projected high over the apices); "L" side marker at image upper right confirms conventional orientation (patient's right on image left)
technical_quality: Adequate penetration and contrast; no significant rotation (spinous processes midline between clavicular heads); poor inspiratory effort with both hemidiaphragms elevated to roughly the anterior 4th-5th rib level, low lung volumes - this magnifies the cardiomediastinal silhouette and crowds the basal vessels, limiting assessment of heart size and lung bases. Whole thorax and shoulders included; large body habitus with thick lateral chest wall soft tissues.

devices.location: Image upper right corner, over the patient's left shoulder region (external, not on the patient)

abnormalities.finding: Cardiac silhouette borderline-to-mildly enlarged with a globular contour; transverse cardiac diameter approx 17 cm, cardiothoracic ratio approx 0.5 (measured right border ~x410 to left border ~x730 vs inner thoracic width ~630 px); probably accentuated by poor inspiration and AP projection
Bilateral elevated hemidiaphragms (right slightly higher than left) with low lung volumes / poor inspiration; bibasilar vascular crowding without frank consolidation

Hazy increased density in the right perihilar / infrahilar region adjacent to the right heart border with a somewhat prominent right hilum - most consistent with crowded vessels from low lung volumes, early infiltrate or right middle lobe partial collapse not excluded (left hilum normal in size and density)

Large upper abdominal shadow with gastric fundal gas under the left hemidiaphragm and hepatic-flexure colonic gas under the right hemidiaphragm; no free subdiaphragmatic air - incidental, suggests obesity or abdominal distension contributing to the diaphragmatic elevation

description_zh: 胸部正面像（疑為AP投照），吸氣不足，兩側橫膈明顯上抬至前第4-5肋水平，肺容積偏小，兩側下肺野血管擁擠。心影呈球狀、橫徑約17 cm，心胸比約0.5，屬臨界至輕度心臟擴大，惟受吸氣不足與投照方式影響可能高估。右側肺門旁及右心緣旁見模糊增高密度並右肺門略顯突出，以血管擁擠為主，需與早期浸潤或右中葉部分塌陷區別；兩側上肺野清晰，肋膈角銳利，未見肋膜積液或氣胸，縱膈與氣管居中。未見任何管路、引流管或植入物，僅見L側標記；骨骼無明顯骨折，左橫膈下見胃泡、右橫膈下見結腸氣體，無游離氣體。
